name: Sky — Moon Phase
description: Current moon phase + illumination, age (days since new moon), upcoming new / first-quarter / full / last-quarter dates, and (optionally) tonight's moonrise + moonset. Phase + age are computed locally from the synodic month; moonrise/moonset comes from Open-Meteo when latitude/longitude are set.

cell_options.name: latitude
cell_options.label: Latitude
cell_options.help: Used for moonrise / moonset. Leave at default if you don't care.
